protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS. Real CWE-348: IncomingRequest::isSecure() treated client-controlled X-Forwarded-Proto=https and Front-End-Https as proof of HTTPS with no REMOTE_ADDR/trusted-proxy gate. Source: those headers on the request object (or $_SERVER HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO / HTTP_FRONT_END_HTTPS historically). Sink: isSecure() returning true, then force_https()/forceGlobalSecureRequests (system/Common.php:517 at v4.7.3 skips the HTTPS redirect when isSecure()), ForceHTTPS filter, cookie Secure checks, and app HTTPS decisions. CVE-2026-63220 is PUBLISHED (cvelistV5 state PUBLISHED, GitHub_M CNA, not rejected); GHSA-7wmf-pw8j-mc78 withdrawn_at is null. Pre-fix tests at v4.7.3 testIsSecureForwarded/testIsSecureFrontEnd assert true after only appending those headers. Direct fix ecbf044666bed41d23f07518096d9843fe6c08b0 inserts isFromTrustedProxy() before both header branches.
